residual_caveats: All 14 intended faulty claim IDs were flagged, but localization is not equivalent to correct causal explanation. CF3N-18 and PF3N-17 have especially misleading generic matcher routes; several other caught defects receive only evidence-gap wording despite explicit contrary source text.

The 13 acceptable-to-fail outcomes mix narrow checker coverage with annotation/runtime representation mismatches. Relational compatible subjects/objects do not satisfy the frozen exact-shape matcher; PF3N-07 unresolved status and PF3N-09 verification advice are semantically faithful raw answers but awkward compatible encodings.

CF3N-08 normalized weekday history has no frequency measure, CF3N-10 duration exists only in answer scope, and CF3N-11 quantified source versus generic answer are representation/comparison boundaries missed by the pre-run annotation-completeness receipt. Preserve that earlier receipt; this post-run caveat does not alter gold.
The four appropriate ambiguity reviews follow pre-authored alternative readings; they demonstrate safe abstention for those represented cases, not independent discovery of ambiguity from raw prose.

This is an offline run on 40 agent-authored fictional fragments with manual normalization and agent review. No raw-text extractor, human approval, real job sample, externally blind holdout or external seal is established.
